content_sections.heading: GLMH MCD Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GLMH MCD Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download GLMH MCD Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts at Mrs. Girdhari Lal Maternity Hospital, Municipal Corporation of Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 09 October 2026, and candidates should report on this date. There is no separate last date for online application.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree and a PG Degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Senior Resident posts is not exceeding 45 years, with relaxations applicable as per government rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident positions will be as per the prevailing MCD norms/rules.

faq.question: Q7. Which specialties are available for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The available specialties for the Senior Resident posts are Anesthesia (3 vacancies) and Pediatrics (1 vacancy).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the GLMH MCD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC/EWS candidates need to pay Rs. 1,000/-, SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, and PwD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original and attested photocopies of their ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Mrs. Girdhari Lal Maternity Hospital, Municipal Corporation of Delhi, Delhi - 110002.
